# Environment notes (devenv)

- GitHub: you act as the machine account `@@BOT_LOGIN@@`. Commits are authored as `@@BOT_LOGIN@@ <@@BOT_EMAIL@@>`.
- Git workflow and merges are governed by Firstmate's `AGENTS.md` in `$FM_HOME`. Never merge a PR without the captain's explicit word.
- Firstmate project clones (`$FM_PROJECTS_OVERRIDE`, normally `~/fm-projects`) and treehouse worktrees (`~/.treehouse`) are on this machine's local disk, not in the workspace. They are lost when the sandbox is removed, so push your work.
- This environment is built by devenv (`digigrant/devenv`). It runs from the clone in `$DEVENV_DIR`, which is also the Firstmate project clone of devenv. Change devenv only in a worktree on a branch and deliver it by PR; never edit or switch that clone's own checkout, because the running environment uses it. The workspace's parent folder is not the devenv repo.
- Never add shell-completion scripts to `/etc/sandbox-persistent.sh`. It is sourced before every command, and completion scripts break the shell.
- Android: `adb` is installed, and an Android emulator can run on the host (started there with `devenv emulator start`; you can't start it from here). Run tests against it with `devenv emulator run -- <command>`, for example `devenv emulator run -- ./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest`: it connects adb and takes turns with other workers. `devenv emulator status` says whether it's reachable and, if not, what has to happen on the host.
